verdict.rationale: Cactus's own documented design lets users keep data on their own hardware: on-device inference with "no data leaving the device" and free local LoRA fine-tuning where you bring your own hardware and data. That is effectively a choice between local-only storage and the hosted platform. However, the hosted platform documents no region or residency selection. Its optional cloud routing of hard queries sends data off-device to an unspecified location. missing for 10: region/residency selection for hosted fine-tuning and uploaded data, documented storage locations for cloud routing, data-residency or retention policy docs, independent corroboration.
